user.title: WLED More-Info
user.description: Adds the WLED more-info card. It works with every WLED device of the WLED integration.

data.replace_more_info: Use the WLED card in every WLED light's more-info

data_description.replace_more_info: Everywhere in Home Assistant (dashboards, search, history, the app), opening a WLED segment light shows the WLED card inside the native more-info. Reload the browser after changing it.
